sources_considered.why: Controlled scaling experiments provide relevant context, but test different models and finite scales.
Targeted training data improve physical behavior in Open-Sora; material evidence against interpreting the claim as saying data cannot help.
A later Sora release reports improved physics, but does not isolate additional data or establish elimination of the failures.

evidence_items.explanation: The experiments identify limits to physics generalization alongside successful generalization in other settings. They test research models rather than OpenAI's Sora and do not prove that every larger training dataset must fail.

Additional simulated training examples improve falling-object behavior without changing Open-Sora's training objective. This demonstrates that data can remedy particular physical behaviors, but the model and task do not match a general solution for OpenAI's Sora.

OpenAI reports improved physics in a later model, while acknowledging remaining mistakes. The announcement does not attribute the improvement to data alone or demonstrate that the relevant glitches have been solved.
